# Material Color Utilities

App-owned source snapshot of the Apache-2.0 Material Color Utilities included in Google Material Components for Android 1.13.0. This preserves the existing artwork palette algorithm without calling SDK-internal APIs.

Source: https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/com/google/android/material/material/1.13.0/material-1.13.0-sources.jar

Only the Java package was renamed to `com.librivox.mobile.colorutilities`; original source, annotations, and copyright headers are preserved. The dependency closure used by artwork color extraction is included.
